Specifically, the sections of $\mathcal{L}$ define a map $\psi_{\mathcal{L}}: X \to \mathbb{P}(H^0(X, \mathcal{L})^\vee) = \mathbb{P}^N_K$.

Consequently, the image of any adelic point $(x_v) \in X(\mathbf{A}_K)$ under the product map $\psi_{\mathcal{L}}$ lies in the product of projective spaces over the completions.
